## DEFENSE SCHEME REFERENCE (2025-26)

| Scheme | Teams | Impact |
|--------|-------|--------|
| PAINT_PACK | OKC, BOS, DET, MIN, SAS, ORL | Elite rim protection, gives up 3s |
| BLITZ | HOU, TOR, MIA, PHX | Aggressive pressure, forces TOs |
| PERIMETER | GSW, DAL, NYK | Chases shooters, open driving lanes |
| FUNNEL | WAS, ATL, CHI, UTA, SAC | Exploitable gaps |
| NEUTRAL | LAL, DEN, MIL, BKN, IND, POR, CHA, NOP, PHI | No clear identity |

**Scheme Matchup:**
- ATL Offense vs PHI Defense (NEUTRAL) - No scheme-specific advantage
- PHI Offense vs ATL Defense (FUNNEL) - Exploitable gaps for PHI

### Injury Report (BDL Data)
- **ATL:** Trae Young TRADED TO WAS (not on ATL roster)
- **PHI:** Paul George - status unclear (check pre-game)

### Key Players (Database Archetypes + Recent Stats)

| Player | Archetype | Recent L5+ | Synergy Primary | Matchup Impact |
|--------|-----------|------------|-----------------|----------------|
| **Tyrese Maxey (PHI)** | HELIOCENTRIC | 22.4pts/8.0ast/3.0reb | P&R Handler (26.4%) | vs FUNNEL - favorable driving lanes |

**S.A.V.A.G.E. Notes:**

**Verdict:** PHI frontcourt favorable vs ATL's FUNNEL scheme. Embiid PTS/REB, Maxey PTS/AST are primary targets.

## GAME 2: PHX @ SAS | 8:30 PM ET

**Scheme Matchup:**
- PHX Offense vs SAS Defense (PAINT_PACK) - Rim protection elite, gives up 3s
- SAS Offense vs PHX Defense (BLITZ) - Pressure causes TOs

### Injury Report (BDL Data)
- **PHX:** None listed
- **SAS:** None listed

### Key Players (Database Archetypes + Recent Stats)

| Player | Archetype | Recent L5+ | Synergy Primary | Matchup Impact |
|--------|-----------|------------|-----------------|----------------|
| **Devin Booker (PHX)** | HELIOCENTRIC | 27.2pts/3.8ast/3.8reb | P&R Handler (33.1%), ISO (13.8%) | vs PAINT_PACK - 3PM favorable (+1.34 PPP spot-up) |
| **Victor Wembanyama (SAS)** | SLASHER | 25.0pts/1.7ast/11.5reb | Transition (16.5%), ISO (14.9%) | Rim protection anchors PAINT_PACK |
| **De'Aaron Fox (SAS)** | GENERALIST | 19.0pts/6.8ast/3.7reb | P&R Handler (29.9%), Transition (22.5%) | vs BLITZ - elevated TOV risk |
| **Grayson Allen (PHX)** | TWO_WAY_WING | 18.7pts/4.1ast/3.7reb | Data unavailable | 3PM favorable vs PAINT_PACK |

**S.A.V.A.G.E. Notes:**
- Booker SPOT_UP (1.34 PPP) vs PAINT_PACK = elite 3PM opportunity
- Wembanyama rim protection limits PHX interior scoring
- Fox vs BLITZ defense - P&R handler facing pressure, TOV risk elevated
- Fox TRANSITION (1.05 PPP) - can push pace to avoid half-court pressure

**Archetype vs Scheme:**
- HELIOCENTRIC vs PAINT_PACK = 3PM boost, interior limited
- SLASHER anchoring PAINT_PACK = defensive advantage

**Verdict:** PHX 3PM favorable (Booker, Allen). Wemby REB/BLK favorable (rim anchor). SAS guards face TOV risk vs BLITZ.
